title: Databricks-provided MCP connectors in Genie One and Genie Code will soon be enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting in December 2026, Databricks-provided MCP connectors in Genie One and Genie Code will be enabled by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

The connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Atlassian, Slack, and GitHub. They let Genie One and Genie Code connect to third-party services to search your documents and data and take actions on your behalf. Databricks governs each connection through Unity Catalog and Unity Gateway.

See [Databricks-provided MCPs](/aws/en/agents/mcp-tools/built-in-mcp-services), [Connect Genie One to external tools and sources](/aws/en/genie-one/external-sources), and [Connect Genie Code to MCP servers](/aws/en/genie-code/mcp).
